description: Only when the user asks: change this Discord tool's own settings and save them on this computer: write mode, allowed servers, tool packs on at start, confirmation for permanent actions, default server and the bots' status. Most apply at once; tool groups, read-only mode and the status apply after restarting the app.

dry_run.description: Show the requests that would be made without changing anything

status_text.description: Bot activity text, e.g. the server name; "" = none

tool_groups.description: Extra tool packs to have on from the start (the core tools are always on); ["all"] = every tool, [] = core only

name: configure
